findings.correction: Format all of Wipeng’s transmitted speech as ordinary dialogue or normal blockquotes without a **System** heading: “This is Sound Transmission. Don’t be alarmed—just listen.”
findings.current:
> **System**
>
> - This is Sound Transmission. Do not be alarmed. Listen carefully.
findings.defect: Wipeng’s Sound Transmission is formatted as a System message, falsely identifying the System as the speaker. The same error recurs for every subsequent Sound Transmission line.
findings.rationale: The prose explicitly says Wipeng’s lips move and identifies the voice as Sound Transmission. These are Wipeng’s words, not game notifications.

findings.correction: They were hereditary martial arts of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, forgotten after he had gone far too long without practicing them.
findings.current: They were hereditary martial arts of the Jin Family of Taiyuan—arts I had forgotten because they hadn’t been practiced in far too long.
findings.defect: The passive “they hadn’t been practiced” obscures the subject and can imply that the family arts had fallen out of general use. The source says Taekyung had not practiced them for so long that he had forgotten them.
findings.rationale: The causal subject is Taekyung, not the techniques or the Jin Family as a whole.
findings.source: 너무 오랫동안 수련을 하지 않아 잊고 있었다는 태원진가의 가전 무공이다.

findings.correction: The agenda was obvious. It would begin with Jin Taekyung’s usual conduct and end with an attack on Jin Wikyung himself, the Young Sect Leader.
findings.current: The agenda was obvious. It would begin with Jin Taekyung’s usual conduct and end with an attack on Jin Wikyung himself, the Lesser Family Head.
findings.defect: The source calls Jin Wikyung the Young Sect Leader here, but the translation substitutes Lesser Family Head, changing the stated office and hierarchy.
findings.rationale: 소문주 is explicitly established as **Young Sect Leader**, while 소가주 is **Lesser Family Head**. The source uses 소문주 in this sentence.
findings.source: 회의 안건은 보나 마나 뻔하다. 진태경의 평소 행실로 시작해서 소문주인 자신에 대한 공격으로 끝날 것이다.

findings.correction: A family council meeting may be held soon. From their perspective, they’ve spotted an opening, so naturally they’ll sink their teeth into it.
findings.current: A meeting of the elders may be held soon. From their perspective, they’ve spotted an opening. It’s only natural that they would try to tear into it.
findings.defect: “A meeting of the elders” conflates 가로회의 with the separately named 장로원, the Elder Council. The same conflation recurs later as “the elders’ meeting.”
findings.rationale: The passage distinguishes the Elder Council as the faction applying pressure from the meeting in which that pressure will be exerted.
findings.source: 조만간 가로회의가 열릴지도 모르겠습니다. 저들 입장에서는 틈이 보이니 물어뜯는 것이 당연하지요.

findings.defect: The translation omits Taekyung catching himself after using Wikyung’s bare name and switching to the respectful kinship address. This loses the comic register shift and their hierarchy.
findings.rationale: 아니 marks an explicit self-correction from the name 진위경 to 형님.

findings.correction: If I refused this too, he looked ready to beat me and drag me there if he had to.
findings.current: If I refused this too, he looked like the sort of man who would drag me there by force.
findings.defect: The translation omits the specific threat Taekyung imagines: Wipeng beating him before taking him away.
findings.rationale: 두들겨 패서라도 explicitly means taking him even if Wipeng has to beat him, sharpening both the threat and Taekyung’s comic fear.
findings.source: 이것까지 거절하면 두들겨 패서라도 데려갈 것 같다.

findings.correction: - The movement sequence for **Jin Family’s Manoeuvre Technique** is being displayed. (0 / 100)
findings.current: - The forms of **Jin Family’s Manoeuvre Technique** are being displayed. (0 / 100)
findings.defect: “Forms” is imprecise for 투로 in this mechanical context. The System displays a complete movement route or sequence through footprints, not a collection of forms.
findings.rationale: The following explanation says Taekyung must step through the entire 투로 exactly once, establishing it as a route or sequence.

findings.correction: Feeling strangely choked up, I began eating breakfast.
findings.current: With a thick, stifled expression on my face, I began eating breakfast.
findings.defect: “A thick, stifled expression” is not natural English and does not clearly convey that Taekyung is emotionally choked up.
findings.rationale: 먹먹해진 conveys an emotionally constricted or choked-up feeling prompted by the servant’s concern.
findings.source: 나는 먹먹해진 얼굴로 아침 식사를 시작했다.

summary: One critical speaker-identification error and several hierarchy, subject, register, and characterization defects.
